spec.title: HTTP PUT /k/:key
spec.description: Time to handle a PUT /k/{key} request, for all status codes.

spec.title: DB Average Batch Size
spec.description: Average number of SET and DELETE requests in one commit, up to 128.

spec.title: DB SET Average Phase Duration
spec.description: Average queue wait plus commit time, with the total as a red line.

spec.title: DB Status
spec.description: Turns READ ONLY after a WAL error and stays so until restart.

spec.title: WAL I/O Duration
spec.description: P99 of each pwritev and fdatasync call, the lines don't add up.

spec.title: WAL Write Throughput
spec.description: Bytes per second written to WAL files, including record framing.

spec.title: DB Commit Rate
spec.description: Group commits per second, each with one WAL write and one fdatasync.

spec.title: DB SET average concurrent requests (estd)
spec.description: Estimated SET and DELETE requests in the database at the same time.

spec.title: DB Amortized Commit Cost per SET
spec.description: Commit time per write, which is a cost and not a latency.

spec.title: DB Commit Backlog
spec.description: Requests already queued when a commit starts.

spec.title: DB GET Duration
spec.description: P99 time of a GET, split by where the key was found.

spec.title: HTTP GET /k/:key
spec.description: Time to handle a GET /k/{key} request, for all status codes.

spec.title: DB GET Rate
spec.description: GETs per second, split by where the key was found.

spec.title: SST Probes per GET
spec.description: SST tables checked by one GET, zero when the memtable answers.

spec.title: SST Bloom Filter Checks
spec.description: Bloom filter answers per second during GETs.

spec.title: SST Bloom False Positive Rate
spec.description: Share of tables without the key that the filter still let through.

spec.title: Immutable Memtables
spec.description: Full memtables not yet flushed, growing values mean flush is behind.

spec.title: Memtable Memory
spec.description: Bytes held by the active and immutable memtables.

spec.title: Compaction Errors
spec.description: Failed compaction passes in the selected time range.

spec.title: SST Tables per Level
spec.description: Number of SST tables in each level, L0 tables slow down GETs.

spec.title: SST Size per Level
spec.description: Data bytes stored in each level.

spec.title: Flush Duration
spec.description: Time to write one memtable into an L0 table.

spec.title: HTTP Requests
spec.description: Requests per second for each route, without /metrics scrapes.

spec.title: Compaction Rate
spec.description: Compactions per minute, moves only relabel tables and merges rewrite them.

spec.title: Compaction Duration
spec.description: P99 time of one compaction, by kind.

spec.title: Compaction Throughput
spec.description: Bytes per second read and written by merge compactions.

spec.title: Disk Write Throughput
spec.description: Disk writes stacked by stage, with DB.SET bytes as the dashed line.

spec.title: Write Amplification
spec.description: Disk bytes written for each byte of user data.

spec.title: WAL Retained Size
spec.description: WAL bytes kept for recovery, growing values mean flush is stuck.

spec.title: WAL Rollover Duration
spec.description: Time to switch to a new segment, by whether it was prepared.

spec.title: WAL Rollovers
spec.description: Segment switches in the selected range, stalled and unprepared ones slow commits.

spec.title: Memory
spec.description: Go heap in use, the next GC target and resident process memory.

spec.title: Average GC Pause
spec.description: Average stop-the-world GC pause.

spec.title: Goroutines
spec.description: Number of live goroutines.

spec.title: DB SET Total Duration
spec.description: Time from entering the commit queue until the batch is committed.

spec.title: DB SET Wait Duration
spec.description: Time a SET or DELETE waits in the queue before its commit starts.

spec.title: DB Group Commit Phase Duration
spec.description: P99 of each commit step, the lines don't add up to the commit P99.
